fact: ANATS, a public establishment created by Ordonnance N°001/PR/2016, states it is responsible for producing, managing and securing identity cards and other secure titles, and that it set up the SIGPTS.
ANATS's director general instructs its user reception centres and the Système Intégré Sécurisé director to enrol school leavers for the NNI with priority, so the national agency runs enrolment.
ANATS, the National Agency for Secure Documents, already operates SIGPTS, the Integrated Population and Secure Document Management System, per We are Tech.
